samples.question: On a white canvas there is a scattered constellation of equal-sized colored dots: one red, one green, one blue, one purple, one orange, and one teal. Look at the whole cloud of dots together. Its center of mass -- the single point where all the dots would balance -- lies exactly on one of the dots. Which color dot sits right on the center of mass of the entire constellation? Answer red, green, blue, purple, orange, or teal.
